windows.keyed-write: Typed or Wire input through preparation, settlement, SQL lowering, production bind adaptation, and psycopg's document serialization; no database execution
windows.model-preparation: one complete model preparation from the declared Entity Classes
windows.predicate-acquisition: a prepared Bitemporal updateUntil predicate and freshly composed resolving rows through production acquisition to a buffered Materialized Write Group; no ingress preparation, JSON parsing, flush, or serialization
windows.wire-insert-response: one public tx.wire.insert of a nested, polymorphic Create Payload inside an open transaction, from the payload arriving to the frozen node it answers; no flush, lowering, or serialization
